title: A Checks-and-Balances Framework for Context-Aware Ethical AI Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the framework's ability to handle culturally sensitive vocabulary and adapt ethical guardrails to different cultural contexts using adversarial in-context reviews (Dike vs. Eris) to avoid enforcing a single universal standard of speech.

Preliminary testing of context-adaptive interpretation on racial and ethnic slurs (e.g., "yid", "paki", "chinaman") to distinguish between neutral in-group usage and offensive out-group usage, as well as evaluating the modulation of anti-immigrant language.

Measuring inter-annotator entropy in emotion and behavior classification tasks to highlight human subjectivity, and using dialectic dual-LLM debates to mitigate subjective biases in ethical judgments.
